Risk Description:
The risk that the claims and premium
liabilities estimated are lower than the
actual claims that the company ends
up settling.
Source of Risk:
• Lower claims liabilities than projected.
• Lower claims liabilities than projected.
Mitigation:
Adequate pricing, underwriting, claims
management and regular profit testing.
Best practice internal actuarial standards.
Semi-annual independent review of the actuarial
reserves and methodology by the Appointed
Actuary.
Additional capital held as per the Risk-Based
Capital regulation to cushion the company against
this risk.
